---
title: "Signal QC"
---

Signal quality control with PeacoQC.

## `sw_qc_run` {#sw_qc_run}

Signal quality control on a single flowFrame.

### Usage

```r
sw_qc_run(ff, channels = NULL, IT_limit = 0.55, MAD = 6,
             output_dir = NULL, ...)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `ff` | A `flowFrame`. |
| `channels` | Optional character vector of channels to check. If `NULL`, fluorescent channels are auto-detected. |
| `IT_limit` | Isolation Tree anomaly score threshold (default: 0.55). |
| `MAD` | MAD multiplier for outlier detection (default: 6). |
| `output_dir` | Optional directory for QC plots and reports. |
| `...` | Additional arguments passed to `PeacoQC::PeacoQC()`. |

### Details

Wrapper for `PeacoQC::PeacoQC()` with sensible defaults for spectral flow
cytometry data. Identifies and removes events with aberrant signal behaviour
using Isolation Trees and MAD-based methods.

### Value

A list with components: `FinalFF` (cleaned flowFrame), `GoodCells` (logical
vector), `n_removed`, `pct_removed`.

---

## `sw_qc_batch` {#sw_qc_batch}

Batch signal quality control.

### Usage

```r
sw_qc_batch(ff_list, ...)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `ff_list` | A named list of `flowFrame` objects. |
| `...` | Additional arguments passed to `sw_qc_run()`. |

### Details

Applies `sw_qc_run()` to each flowFrame in the list and returns cleaned
frames plus summary statistics.

### Value

A list with components: `cleaned` (named list of cleaned flowFrames),
`summary` (tibble with per-sample QC statistics).

---

## `sw_qc_summary` {#sw_qc_summary}

QC summary report.

### Usage

```r
sw_qc_summary(qc_results, threshold = 30)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `qc_results` | Output from `sw_qc_batch()`. |
| `threshold` | Percentage threshold for flagging high-removal samples (default: 30). |

### Details

Tabulates cells removed per sample and flags samples with removal rates
exceeding the threshold.

### Value

A `tibble` with columns: `sample`, `n_before`, `n_after`, `n_removed`,
`pct_removed`, and `flagged` (logical).
